subsystems.name: Build system & toolchain
subsystems.notes: clang i686 + SDL3, ninja, one command

subsystems.name: Asset pipeline (ROM symbols)
subsystems.notes: 61k symbols pinned to the ROM, 47 native relocations

subsystems.name: GBA memory map & ROM loading
subsystems.notes: address space embedded in the PE image; NULL and out-of-range accesses emulate the GBA bus (port_biosfault.c)

subsystems.name: BIOS services
subsystems.notes: CpuSet, CpuFastSet, LZ77, BgAffineSet, Sqrt, reset

subsystems.name: DMA controller
subsystems.notes: immediate, VBlank, HBlank with register latching

subsystems.name: Interrupts & frame timing
subsystems.notes: exact 59.7275 Hz pacing, one game update per VBlank (verified against BizHawk); FPS and logic-rate readout

subsystems.name: PPU renderer
subsystems.notes: modes 0-5, affine, windows, blending, mosaic, OBJ window; HUD layer follows GBA priorities (message windows stay in front); affine BGs now take the mosaic (the battle card-break effect pixelates the arena as on the GBA); reviewed against the hardware rules: window priority (WIN0 > WIN1 > OBJ window > outside), semi-transparent OBJ blending regardless of the window's effect bit, backdrop as second target; scene regression (port/tools/test_ppu.py, references in evidence/ppu_refs.json): language select, title, debug menu, battle, card-break mosaic, field room, castle hall, movie, world map, status, journal and deck menu render in the original view and are checked against reviewed references

subsystems.name: Input (keyboard / gamepad)
subsystems.notes: remappable keyboard (two keys per action) and gamepad buttons in kh_com.ini and the launcher; one-button dodge roll and stock (L+R); right stick changes and stocks cards; optional return-stocked-cards button (hold V / right stick)

subsystems.name: m4a sequencer & mixer
subsystems.notes: full C port of m4a_1.s, 4x oversampled mixing; song loops checked against the ROM's sequence data; compared with BizHawk over boot and title: sample correlation 0.90, 4 ppm drift, port 3.5 dB quieter (overall output gain, the same on movies) and without the stepped-PCM images above 3 kHz; 4 minutes of title music hold the same figures; every named song and sound effect played (port/tools/test_songs.py, report in port/progress/songs_report.txt): 590/637 sound with no sequencer error and no clipping, the other 47 are empty in the cartridge (38 point at the silent gSongSnd0, 9 are past the 962-entry table)

subsystems.name: PSG (CGB) channels
subsystems.notes: square+sweep (band-limited), wave, noise, envelopes, length, NR50-52 routing; 79 songs/effects use CGB voices (KHCOM_SONG plays one); one wave RAM bank, as m4a's bank switching within a frame produces the same result; 77 songs and effects that use the PSG play without errors; sweep overflow at trigger and after each update, noise shifts 14/15 stop the generator; m4a only ever plays wave bank 0, so one bank is exact

subsystems.name: PCM streaming (FIFO)
subsystems.notes: FIFO A/B fed by the DMA aimed at them, each at its own timer's rate; movie audio identical before/after, rate exact; castle movie compared with BizHawk (port/tools/audio_compare.py): sample correlation 0.99, flat -3.5 dB in every band (the port's overall gain)

subsystems.name: Block audio codec transform
subsystems.notes: transform.s in C

subsystems.name: Movie (FMV) decoder
subsystems.notes: native C; all 3605 video frames and 3604 audio blocks match ARM; all five movies play to their last frame and hand over to the next scene (castle, Larxene, Destiny Islands, staff roll) â€” KHCOM_MOVIE

subsystems.name: Save data (SRAM)
subsystems.notes: kh_com.sav (per version) next to the exe, atomic writes; quick save, restart and load verified; five save banks (kh_com_bank<n>.sav) chosen in the options or the launcher

subsystems.name: Soft reset
subsystems.notes: A+B+Select+Start returns to the language select; game globals restored from a snapshot

subsystems.name: Widescreen: renderer
subsystems.notes: world-map extension for map-block BGs, full-range sprite positions, per-scene validation

subsystems.name: Widescreen: field maps
subsystems.notes: map-block and cell-built rooms extend with the game's own composition (MapWorldTile matches MapBuildBgRow/Column, 417216 comparisons); beyond the world the room's own backdrop. Every reachable story room in EU, US and JP (118/120 unique rooms each; the two others are an encounter before the capture, reviewed separately), fixed halls of all 13 floors and 100 Acre Wood reviewed (evidence/fieldmaps_wide.txt)

subsystems.name: Widescreen: battles
subsystems.notes: affine arenas extend with bands of their own original tiles chosen per arena (btl_map.c); HUD on its own scaled layer, card hand lifted, tutorial pointers follow the HUD, battle messages docked; battle entry keeps its native aspect with dim surroundings. 19/19 arenas reviewed in EU, US and JP; exit reviewed with the battlewin fixture from a debug battle and a field room (back to the room, next entry), no crash (evidence/battles_wide.txt)

subsystems.name: Widescreen: menus & events
subsystems.notes: pause/save/world selection/level up/door menu on the screen layer; headers, eye tabs and bands from the original assets (letter-free band in EU/US/JP); six submenus reviewed frame by frame on real navigation; level-up entry/exit from a field battle; world cards pixel fade and world map in US/JP; door menu raised above the bottom bar (evidence/menus_wide.txt)

subsystems.name: Graphics options menu
subsystems.notes: overlay with the game font, 5 languages, live changes; HUD size, HD text, control options; opened from title (SELECT), F1/Esc, Back+Start; drawn in the style of the cartridge's debug menu (its bars, red cursor square and Sora picture decoded from the ROM), checked in EU languages and Japanese; the skip-intro prompt, state notices and title hint use the same button; port/tools/test_options.py: every value of the 18 options runs and the battle picture changes where it should (35 cases); zoom Near equals Normal and HUD Larger equals Large where the window allows no other whole-number scale (720p/1080p); the menu renders in the five EU languages, US and JP (evidence/options.txt)

subsystems.name: Gameplay verification
subsystems.notes: Earlier EU/US/JP reports: 194 event and 209 debug battle smoke cases per region; bounded runs, not full playthroughs. Twelve traced START/deck/field cycles passed. Add-card crash reproduced through normal navigation and fixed by initializing caption counts; Add/Remove/field regression passed. Other repeated submenu crashes remain under investigation.; room battery (port/tools/test_rooms.py, KHCOM_MODE=room as the debug MAP check enters rooms): 52/52 in EU, every world on an early and a late floor and the entrance and exit halls of all 13 floors, walking, opening doors and fighting (evidence/rooms_eu.txt); level-up holds 16.7 ms frames with no hitch or lost logic frame (KHCOM_FRAMELOG); save states deterministic; every song played. Full playthroughs still pending.; submenu stress (port/tools/test_submenus.py) on a real save: every pause-menu entry (deck, world map, map cards, world cards, status, journal) entered and left four times, 6/6 with no crash (evidence/submenus_eu.txt); correction: of the room battery's worlds, index 12 is the FORMAT debug stage and Twilight Town on floor 1 is a placeholder, and the MAP table has no 100 Acre Wood, so those cases are entries without crash rather than story scenarios; every reachable story room entered as Sora in EU/US/JP (118/120 unique rooms each, the other two an encounter before the capture) and as Riku/Reverse-Rebirth in EU (88/88); battles won to the field and level up from a field battle (battlewin/levelup fixtures). Full natural playthroughs still pending (the last item). Closed by the owner's decision (14/10): a full automated playthrough is not viable for now (the TAS was discarded and the playthrough bot, KHCOM_BOT, only covers the opening, the tutorial battle and the first room); the complete runs of Sora and Reverse/Rebirth are left to player feedback

subsystems.name: Save states
subsystems.notes: F5/F9, slots F6/F7; SRAM excluded; validated per build; determinism test (port/tools/test_savestate.py): a state saved mid-battle and loaded in a new process plays on pixel-identical for 1700 frames with input, as Sora, Riku and against a boss (3/3)

subsystems.name: HD text
subsystems.notes: KHMenu Latin/menu text, Japanese glyphs and Comic Hearts subtitles. Fresh EU/JP opening captures verified after Shift-JIS fix. Map-card tutorial caption hidden while its notice is open; general occlusion regression, stylized art and remaining digits still pending.; inventory of text and digits still in pixel art (port/progress/HDTEXT_INVENTARIO.md): dialogue, menu slots, card names, subtitles and the options screen are HD; card values, reload counters and boss values are card art and stay; deck-menu counts are text written into BG tiles, left for the compositor work; EXP/next-level digits drawn as HD (style 2, 5-pixel capitals on 8-pixel cells) and deck-menu digits registered from their BG tiles (PortRegisterBgTextTile); visual approval of the corrected colours pending; numbers: deck-menu digits take the face/shadow of their own cell's palette (lighter colour as face, greyed-out decks stay grey), the pixel digit gives way to the panel colour so occlusion keeps the glyph in front, and each digit keeps the height and baseline of its pixel ink; reviewed in EU, US and JP (test_text_options_hd.py --deck) with the EXP digits; fonts are found in the data folder when the game runs from bin/

subsystems.name: USA and Japanese versions
subsystems.notes: Separate native builds and per-region saves. Regression on 2026-10-13/14: US 194/194 events, 209/209 battles as Sora and 209/209 as Riku; JP 192/194 events (the last two, Riku's ending, were cut by stopping the run, not by a crash), 209/209 battles as Sora and 209/209 as Riku. Options screen, prompts and HD text checked in Japanese; v0.7 package boots all three.

subsystems.name: Launcher & ROM install
subsystems.notes: decompui (Dear ImGui): installs any of the three dumps by SHA-1, settings, enhancements, editable controls, game language (EU), save card (date, open folder, back up), launcher language, version; starts the matching game; install tests (port/tools/test_launcher.py) 11/11: three dumps, reinstall, wrong size/SHA-1/file, missing file, unwritable roms folder, English UI; save bank selector

subsystems.name: Skip intro
subsystems.notes: A shows a prompt in the game's font with an A button; A again skips the opening
